Subject: Pilot resources for community AI lab

Hi Mina,

I lead research and education at Community Data Lab (501(c)(3)), a small nonprofit that runs community-driven data science workshops for underserved high school and college students. We're preparing a 12-week pilot this fall that will let 20 students build small NLP projects (chatbots for local services) and run lightweight research evaluations on model behavior with human-in-the-loop annotations.

We'd love to evaluate Redwood as our backend for generation + embeddings. Specifically we're requesting:
- $2,000 in platform credits or equivalent token allocation (estimate: ~150k tokens)
- A trial extension to 60–90 days to cover the full pilot window

Attached is a short project proposal and budget. Our constraints: student data will be public / donated, but we do collect minimal contact info. We need confirmation about data residency, retention, and whether there are any special agreements (DPA) or redacted SOC2 evidence we can share with our funders.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if useful. We start workshops week of Sep 13 and would need access by early Sep.

Thanks for considering —
Elena
